xna-type.name: SignedInGamer
xna-type.summary: Represents a gamer (a profile that has an associated gamertag) on the local system.
xna-type.remarks: Gamers can be either on a local system or in a multiplayer session. For more information about gamers in a multiplayer session, see NetworkGamer .

property.name: GameDefaults
property.remarks: Wherever possible, games should default to these values.

property.name: IsGuest
property.summary: Determines whether the gamer is the guest of an Xbox LIVE–enabled profile.
property.value: true if the gamer is a guest; false otherwise.

property.name: IsSignedInToLive
property.summary: Determines whether the gamer has an Xbox LIVE–enabled profile.
property.value: true if the gamer is able to sign in to Xbox LIVE; false otherwise.

property.name: PartySize
property.value: The current number of members in this signed-in gamer's LIVE Party.
property.remarks: This is a read-only property. You cannot use it to set the party size. On platforms such as Windows Phone that do not support Xbox LIVE parties, the value of this property is always zero.

property.name: PlayerIndex
property.summary: Gets the index of the gamer.

exceptions.exception: Thrown if the associated profile is no longer valid. For example, the profile may have signed out.

property.name: Presence
property.summary: Gets an object that may be used to set the rich presence state for this gamer.
property.value: An object that may be used to set the rich presence state for this gamer.
property.remarks: Zune Specific Information Setting presence information is not supported on the Zune platform. On the Zune platform, setting presence information for a signed-in gamer will not change the presence information on Xbox LIVE. Note Game titles will not be displayed in a player's presence information on the Xbox LIVE service until the game passes peer review. Once a game passes peer review, the presence information for a player will show three things: a confirmation the player is playing an Xbox LIVE Community Game, the game's title, and finally the presence information set by SignedInGamer.Presence . Xbox LIVE Community Game My Game Title Fighting the Boss While a game is in development, but before the game passes peer review, the presence information indicates the developer is using the XNA Creators Club. XNA Creators Club creators.xna.com Fighting the Boss

property.name: Privileges
property.summary: Describes what operations a gamer is allowed to perform.
property.value: The operations a gamer is allowed to perform.
property.remarks: Privileges can be defined by parental control settings, and also will be set automatically in response to things like age, region, and whether the gamer has a LIVE Gold or LIVE Silver membership. Games do not need to explicitly check privileges, because a GamerPrivilegeException will be thrown if an unsupported operation is selected. However, these privilege bits may be useful to detect that an operation is unavailable before calling it so as to grey-out the relevant menu option.

method.name: AwardAchievement
method.summary: [Deprecated] Awards the specified achievement to a locally signed-in gamer.

overload.summary: [Deprecated] Awards the specified achievement to a locally signed-in gamer.

parameters.parameter: Identifier specifying the achievement to award.

overload.remarks: Important This function is deprecated: use the asynchronous method BeginAwardAchievement to award an achievement, which also provides result information.

method.name: BeginAwardAchievement
method.summary: Starts an asynchronous operation to award an achievement to a locally signed-in gamer.

overload.summary: Starts an asynchronous operation to award an achievement to a locally signed-in gamer.

parameters.parameter: Identifier specifying the achievement to award.
The method to be called once the asynchronous operation iss finished.

overload.returns: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the method. Call EndAwardAchievement to access these results.
overload.remarks: Warning This method retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this method returns immediately with a predetermined default value.

method.name: BeginGetAchievements
method.summary: Starts an asynchronous achievement query operation.

overload.summary: Starts an asynchronous achievement query operation.

parameters.parameter: The method to be called once the asynchronous operation is finished.

overload.returns: Type: IAsyncResult An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the method. Call EndGetAchievements to access these results.
overload.remarks: Warning This method retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this method returns immediately with a predetermined default value.

method.name: EndAwardAchievement
method.summary: Ends an asynchronous achievement award operation.

overload.summary: Ends an asynchronous achievement award operation.

parameters.parameter: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the operation.

overload.remarks: Warning This method retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this method returns immediately with a predetermined default value.

method.name: EndGetAchievements
method.summary: Ends an asynchronous achievement query operation.

overload.summary: Ends an asynchronous achievement query operation.

parameters.parameter: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the operation.

overload.remarks: Warning This method retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this method returns immediately with a predetermined default value. The collection returned will include both earned and unearned achievements. Check Achievement.IsEarned to determine whether an achievement has been earned by the gamer.

method.name: GetAchievements
method.summary: Returns the collection of all achievements that may be earned by this gamer.

overload.summary: Returns the collection of all achievements that may be earned by this gamer.
overload.remarks: Warning This method retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this method returns immediately with a predetermined default value. The collection returned will include both earned and unearned achievements. Check Achievement.IsEarned to determine whether an achievement has been earned by the gamer. This is a blocking call. To query asynchronously, use BeginGetAchievements and EndGetAchievements instead.

method.name: GetFriends
method.summary: Reads the friends list of this local gamer. This includes both the gamertags of the friends and their current presence information.

overload.summary: Reads the friends list of this local gamer. This includes both the gamertags of the friends and their current presence information.
overload.returns: The friends of this local gamer.

exceptions.exception: This object has already been disposed.
A signed-in gamer profile is required to perform this operation. A LIVE profile may also be required. There are no profiles currently signed in, or the profile is not signed in to LIVE.

method.name: IsFriend
method.summary: Queries whether the specified gamer is a friend of this local gamer.

overload.summary: Queries whether the specified gamer is a friend of this local gamer.
overload.returns: true if the specified gamer is a friend of the local gamer; false otherwise.

exceptions.exception: A signed in gamer profile is required to perform this operation. A LIVE profile may also be required. There are no profiles currently signed in, or the profile is not signed in to LIVE.
The gamer object has already been disposed.

method.name: IsHeadset
method.summary: Determines if the passed microphone is a headset associated with this signed-in gamer. Use this method to determine if a specific microphone is a gamer-bound headset.

overload.summary: Determines if the passed microphone is a headset associated with this signed-in gamer. Use this method to determine if a specific microphone is a gamer-bound headset.

parameters.parameter: The microphone to check against this signed-in gamer.

overload.returns: Type: Boolean true if the microphone is associated with this signed-in gamer; false otherwise.

event.name: SignedIn
event.summary: Occurs when a new gamer signs into the local system.
event.remarks: This event is raised during calls to Update . When this event is raised, the LocalGamers collection will contain the newly signed-in gamer.

event.name: SignedOut
event.summary: Occurs when a gamer signs out on the local system.
event.remarks: This event is raised during calls to Update . When this event is raised, the LocalGamers collection will not longer contain the signed-out gamer.
